pages.text: Shared ownership is configured through a $(l:companions/commander)Command Slime$(). The original owner UUID remains the primary identity in worlds and stored items. Only that player may change shared owners or enemies. Giving someone a stored item does not grant ownership.

Shared owners may tune, name, dye, heal, recover, revive, equip, ride, link, and command these companions. Follow uses the player who issued it; unavailable choices fall back to an available owner. Removing shared access takes effect on the server immediately.

Shared owners can use guardian protection. Automatic transport, monitoring, healing, and marked-item collection across different primary owners require each primary owner to share with the other. A one-sided invitation never authorizes the inviter to access the other team’s stores.

An assigned enemy is treated by fighting companions as Hostile. Player combat still respects the server PvP setting, Creative immunity, teams, and target filters. Shared owners cannot be enemies; sharing removes an existing enemy assignment.
